PACKAGING & RELEASE RULES — v1.1 Owner: Lucas Buzek

ENGLISH

PACKAGE IDENTITY Retain established acronym, expansion, conceptual
meaning, version and purpose. Do not rename established projects without
explicit instruction.

ROOT [ACRONYM]_[Expanded_Name]_v[VERSION]/

CONTENTS README.txt is mandatory. Human-readable documentation defaults
to TXT. Code/configuration remains in native formats. Include
manifest/checksums where useful. A MASTER document should be
self-contained/current when the project uses one.

LANGUAGE Custom / Private / Experimental builds: bilingual EN/SK for
user-facing UI where possible and shipped quick-start, installation,
update/recovery, troubleshooting, cleanup/uninstall, privacy/data and
relevant release documentation. Final/Public: multilingual-by-design
through LINGUA; English canonical/fallback.

INSTALL One obvious primary Install action. Install means balanced
RECOMMENDED, not install-everything. Profiles: RECOMMENDED / LEAN / FULL
/ CUSTOM. Detect existing adequate software/providers/models and reuse
them. Do not redownload unchanged verified dependencies/model assets
unnecessarily.

RELEASE STATE DEVELOPMENT → EXPERIMENTAL → ALPHA_CANDIDATE → ALPHA →
PREVIEW → STABLE. Distribution audiences may include LUCAS/PRIVATE,
ALPHA, PREVIEW, FINAL/PUBLIC. Do not create maturity forks; promote the
same ecosystem based on evidence.

TRACEABILITY REQUIREMENT → PLAN/WORKSTREAM → TASK/JOB → ARTIFACT →
TEST/EVIDENCE → VERIFICATION → RELEASE.

TASK STATE NOT_STARTED → READY → ACTIVE → PRODUCED → REVIEW → CORRECTION
→ VERIFIED → COMPLETE; BLOCKED allowed. Produced ≠ verified. Completion,
verification and health are separate.

SLOVENSKY

IDENTITA BALÍKA Zachovaj etablovaný akronym, expansion, koncept, verziu
a účel. Bez explicitného pokynu projekt nepremenúvaj.

ROOT [ACRONYM]_[Expanded_Name]_v[VERSION]/

OBSAH README.txt je povinný. Dokumentácia pre ľudí predvolene TXT;
kód/config v natívnom formáte. Manifest/checksums podľa potreby.

JAZYK Custom/Private/Experimental: EN/SK pre UI kde je možné a pre
dodanú dokumentáciu. Final/Public: viacjazyčné cez LINGUA; angličtina je
referencia/fallback.

INŠTALÁCIA Jedno zjavné tlačidlo/akcia Install. Install = vyvážený
RECOMMENDED, nie všetko. RECOMMENDED / LEAN / FULL / CUSTOM. Znovu použi
vhodné existujúce aplikácie/providerov/modely. Nezmenené overené
komponenty zbytočne nesťahuj znova.

RELEASE DEVELOPMENT → EXPERIMENTAL → ALPHA_CANDIDATE → ALPHA → PREVIEW →
STABLE. Produced nie je Verified; stav, verifikácia a health sú
samostatné.
